name: Lau hai san
summary: A seafood hotpot shared at the open-air tables of the night market.
origin: Chợ đêm Côn Đảo. Báo Bà Rịa–Vũng Tàu, 16 May 2025.
howToEat: Order it for the table alongside the seafood you have chosen. The market opens at 17:00.
where: Võ Thị Sáu and Phạm Văn Đồng, in the open yard in front of the daily market.
seoTitle: Lau hai san — seafood hotpot in Con Dao
seoDescription: Lẩu hải sản is the seafood hotpot shared at the Côn Đảo night market.
